fields.Name: T137 - Execution Monitor Metrics and Trends Chart
fields.Description: Bespoke Monitor dashboard with a computed success-rate and a custom stacked bar trend chart — not a grid; unique aggregation/visualization code.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, switch to the 'Actions' application, and open the 'Monitor' nav item (Execution Monitor). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Verify the monitor renders its execution metric cards (Total Executions, Success Rate as a percentage, Failed Executions, Avg Duration, Today, Currently Running) and a '7-Day Execution Trends' chart section (stacked success/failed bars) — or, if there is no execution data, valid empty-states for the chart and the executions list. Seeing the metrics cards and the trends chart section render is success.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Execution Monitor shows metric cards including a Success Rate percentage and Failed/Total counts
A '7-Day Execution Trends' chart section renders with bars OR a clear 'No execution trends available' empty-state
A recent-executions list section is present (populated or with a valid empty-state)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
